description: Add guarded AI provenance to the existing OAH-aligned FHIR Bundle and replace the hardcoded summary with a collapsed inspector derived only from the exact Bundle persisted, validated, displayed, and downloaded.
steps: Add total isExportableAiReview(aiReview,photoId,counts) to src/core/fhir.js, validating nested objects, positive known human taxon, citizen-count source, timestamps, exact photo match, provider/policy/outcome enums, confidence range, policy recomputation, and known-or-null model taxon before any provenance field is read.

Extend buildBundle with aiReview and photoId; emit no AI resource when the guard fails, otherwise add one separate unprofiled ai-identification-second-opinion Observation derived from the human biotic Observation with the exact six Bahari components and exact valueCodeableConcept/valueQuantity encodings from the approved design.

Add inspectBundle(bundle) to index actual fullUrls and parse only actual resource types, OAH profile URLs, one-health-assessment code, subject/specimen/derivedFrom references, and cross-checked AI components; suppress invalid AI provenance without invalidating the core Bundle.

Update src/steps/StepFhir.jsx to create one memoized Bundle from stable semantic inputs, validate/inspect/render/raw/download that object, use a collapsed native details inspector, and call onBundleReady(bundle) after commit.

Add App's memoized active-record handleBundleReady path using latestSnapshotRef and fingerprint deduplication, preserving immutable completedAt and ignoring callbacks after restart/resume/delete/record change; revise Landing and FHIR EN/FR wording to structural validity, prior HAPI evidence, and OAH alignment without formal conformance claims.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed, stale-photo, or policy-inconsistent aiReview never throws and simply omits the AI Observation while the core Bundle remains structurally valid.

Valid AI provenance uses the Bahari system and exactly reviewed-human-taxon, model-taxon when non-defer, model-confidence with UCUM unit/code 1, model-policy-status, comparison-outcome, and model-provider.
The inspector lists only present resources/profile mappings and actual resolvable relationships, and states that AI provenance is not included when it cannot cross-check exported evidence.
The same StepFhir Bundle object is used for validation, inspector, raw JSON, onBundleReady persistence, and application/fhir+json download, with no duplicate save from effect replay.
Visible copy does not say conformant or standards-compliant and does not claim current official profile or HAPI validation.
verification: npm --prefix /home/sierra/Desktop/projects/hackathons/oneaquahealth/.worktrees/trust-chain exec vitest run src/core/fhir.test.js src/App.smoke.test.jsx src/a11y.test.jsx src/i18n/strings.test.js

Browser: compare valid, absent, malformed, and photo-mismatched AI inspector output with raw/downloaded JSON; verify exact components/references/profile labels, one onBundleReady save, stale callback suppression, native disclosure semantics, EN/FR wording, and keyboard access.
findings: Implemented total guarded AI provenance export, including exact photo/count/timestamp/provider/policy/outcome validation and policy recomputation. Valid reviews now add one unprofiled Bahari AI Observation derived from the human biotic Observation with exactly reviewed-human-taxon, optional model-taxon, UCUM model-confidence unit/code 1, model-policy-status, comparison-outcome, and model-provider; invalid, stale-photo, malformed, and policy-inconsistent reviews omit it while the core Bundle remains structurally valid. Added a Bundle-only inspector for actual resources, exact LocationOah/ObservationIndicatorsOah/SpecimenOah mappings, qualitative One Health evidence, subject/specimen/derivedFrom resolution, and strict AI component cross-checking; malformed AI evidence is suppressed with the required absence statement. StepFhir now memoizes one Bundle for validation, inspection, raw JSON, persistence, and application/fhir+json download, renders a collapsed native details disclosure, and App binds the memoized callback to the active saved FHIR-step record with fingerprint deduplication and immutable completedAt. Revised visible EN/FR landing and FHIR wording to structural checks, prior HAPI evidence, and OAH alignment without formal conformance or current official validation claims. Verification: the required focused Vitest command passed 36/36 tests across 4 files; the full suite passed 147/147 across 16 files; npm run build passed and emitted the production assets and dist/sw.js; git diff --check passed. Direct contract checks confirmed valid provenance, invalid/mismatched fallback, exact component order, profile mappings, resolved references, and suppression after a wrong UCUM system. Real Chrome confirmed the inspector is initially collapsed with a focusable native SUMMARY, valid AI raw JSON contains the exact six components and a resolvable derivedFrom link, inspector labels match actual OAH profiles, raw and downloaded Bundles are identical, the settled record receives no effect-replay save, French validation-scope copy is present, an assessment without AI shows the required absence statement, and forbidden visible conformance/current-HAPI claims are absent. Browser caveat: the first persistence timing probe observed the expected later save when asynchronous weather changed the semantic context; the replay check was repeated after that input settled and remained stable.
